The rule appears to be: The 3x3 input grid is used as a "template" to create a 9x9 output grid. Each cell in the input determines whether the corresponding 3x3 block in the output contains a copy of the input grid or all zeros. If the input cell is non-zero, the block gets a copy of the input; if zero, the block is all zeros.
